message.content: Based on the discussions provided, Kieran expresses a desire for Jaime Lannister to have chosen a different path that would have been more aligned with his character development and growth. Specifically, Kieran believes that if Jaime had stayed true to the lessons he learned from Brienne of Tarth, he could have ended up being a true protector of the realm. This scenario would have allowed Jaime to honor his growth and also ensure a safer future for everyone. Kieran thinks that if Jaime had chosen a different course, perhaps stepping away from Cersei completely, it would have showcased his growth more effectively. Instead, Kieran views Jaime's final decision to return to Cersei as a betrayal of the character development he'd shown throughout the series. He wishes Jaime had chosen a path that would have been more consistent with his evolving values and less tied to his past experiences.
